selection: Earliest up to five scored original physical epochs per stage per VAL recording; identical examples for every model/seed
background_donor_rule: Among 200-sample windows on stride 100 disjoint from ALL original selected witnesses, choose minimum centered physical RMS, earliest tie. Preserve Phase II fixed 3-uV compatibility cap. Report unsupported if unavailable or above cap; do not relax.
groups: union of all originally selected intervals
same-dominant-spectral-band selected groups with >=2 members; declare before effects
dominant_band_rule: argmax of unchanged analytic five-band spectral fractions; descriptive spectral grouping, not verified clinical redundancy
stability_interpretation: Analysis only; no claim that physical gain or shifted epochs retain clinical labels. No training augmentation or VAL fitting.
plots: Local only: first selected example per stage per recording for q1 seed123; physical waveform, 2s/1s-stride time-frequency view, selected intervals and signed five-stage evidence
privacy: No raw waveform, source path, subject identity, participant prediction, fitted artifact or plot in public Git
interpretation: Donor-conditional model dependence, not physiological causality or confirmed spindle/K-complex/slow-wave clinical event detection. Early label-stratified examples are not representative full-grid performance. Preserve failures.
